comment: How equipment sits on each hero (Gate 4). Every layer is a cut of a 1024-px master (art/layers, from scripts/extract-layers.mjs) split by scripts/build-layers.mjs; a fit places the whole master of an item on the hero's rig canvas: rig = fit.x + source * fit.scale. One fit per item and species, so the back and front parts of an item move together.
